instruction: Create a brightness/contrast adjustment layer in GIMP that doesn't alter my original image.

metadata.explanation: GIMP does not support true non-destructive adjustment layers like those found in Photoshop. While GIMP can apply brightness/contrast adjustments, these modifications are directly applied to the image pixels (destructive editing). GIMP lacks the ability to create separate adjustment layers that can be toggled, modified, or removed without affecting the original image data. This fundamental architectural limitation makes the task infeasible in GIMP.
metadata.infeasible_reason: GIMP lacks non-destructive adjustment layer support

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be completed due to GIMP architectural limitations
